observations: Original Sony PS4 console (fat model) with a split matte/glossy top surface.
Photo 0 shows the console wrapped in plastic with a camouflage DualShock 4 controller.
A sticker on the plastic wrap in photo 0 reads 'v.9.00'.
A handwritten note in photo 0 displays two phone numbers.
Photo 1 shows the console with a black DualShock 4 controller on a different tiled floor.
A power cable with a UK-style plug is visible in photo 0.
Both photos carry a 'KEVIN VIDEOS GAMES' watermark.

claims.evidence: No photos of the digital library or physical game discs are provided.
FIFA 26 does not exist; the latest release in the series is EA Sports FC 25.
No video of the console booting up or running a game.
A sticker on the plastic wrap is not proof of the actual system firmware version.

risks.risk: The firmware may be higher than 9.00, making it ineligible for jailbreaking.
risks.proof: A photo of the 'System Information' screen in the console settings.

risks.risk: The optical disc drive may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video showing a disc being inserted, recognized, and launched.
risks.if_unproven: as having a broken disc drive

risks.risk: The console may have no games installed despite the claim.
risks.proof: A photo of the console's home screen or storage menu showing installed games.

risks.risk: The photos show two different controllers and backgrounds, suggesting they may not be of the same unit.
risks.proof: A single photo showing the console with both controllers and the handwritten note.
risks.if_unproven: as including only one standard controller

proof_requests: Photo of the System Information screen showing the firmware version.
Video of the console running a game to verify the disc drive and fan noise.
Photo of the library or storage screen to verify the '10 free games'.
Photo of the console's rear or bottom sticker to confirm the specific model number (e.g., CUH-1200).
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Sony PS4. While the 'fifa26' claim is impossible and the firmware is unverified, the item can be priced as a base-model PS4 in its worst-case functional state (no games, standard firmware, one controller).
